review_method: Assistant visually inspected all 141 traffic-sign crops in four contact sheets; retained readable STOP or recognizable red octagonal hand stop faces. No-entry, yield, arrows, sign backs, warnings and ambiguous crops excluded.
box_source: BDD100K official traffic-sign annotations; subclass supplied by visual review
limitations: Teacher-assisted candidate selection biases coverage toward detectable stops; not an exhaustive stop-sign benchmark. Tiny, oblique or missed signs can remain unlabelled. International hand stop faces are included.
